biotools.summary: SNP-Slice is a tool that uses a slice sampling Markov Chain Monte Carlo algorithm to resolve mixed infections by learning SNP-haplotypes and linking them to hosts. It offers a scalable approach to analyze polygenomic data, improving understanding of genetic diversity and co-infection patterns.
